description: This file is a PHP source file for a module detail view in the vtiger CRM system. It initializes and prepares data for displaying the detail view of a specific record, including setting up Smarty templates, handling permissions, record info, related lists, and custom links.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Class for CRM entity operations, providing a getInstance static method for retrieving entity objects.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class customized for vtiger CRM.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Class handling custom link generation for modules.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to get an instance of a CRMEntity for a specific module.

methods.name: markAsViewed
methods.description: Marks the current record as viewed for change notification.
